experimental_design: longitudinal time-course analysis of cetuximab resistance in OECM-1 cells

OECM-1 cells were treated with cetuximab (500 μg/mL) for 30 passages over more than 2 months, and samples from different passages were collected for RNA sequencing (Table S3) and proteomic analysis (Table S4)
factor_value: cetuximab exposure duration (early ≤8 passages, mid 8–12 passages, late ≥18 passages)

single-sample gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) showed strong enhancement of pro-inflammatory signatures, including IFN-γ and IFN-α, during early cetuximab exposure (≤8 passages), which diminished in later passages (>8 passages). Epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) signaling increased in mid-passages (8–12 passages), while metabolic reprogramming and DNA repair pathways were enriched in late passages (≥18 passages)
